title: Perfect constant realization is complete in the intrinsic Cech presentation
statement: For any scheme T, Noetherian commutative coefficient ring A in the coefficient universe, and adic coefficient datum d on A, a perfect scalar complex P has intrinsically complete completed constant realization integralConstantDerived T d(P), for every finite generating list of d.ideal and every representative complex C and realization eC. This asserts no slice-model comparison or preservation under scheme pullback. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaf and the fixed intrinsic Koszul unit.

source.place: Proposition 6.6.11; Lemmas 6.5.8 and 6.6.8, with the recorded completed coefficient comparisons.

proof.text: Present the perfect scalar object by its bounded finite-projective complex. On the exact AsSmall.{0} pro-etale model used by intrinsic completion, repeat the existing constant-sheafification comparison and scalar-extension adjunction comparison; all termwise maps and differentials are identified. Finite-projective retracts and the slice multiplication-difference calculation prove local ringed-ideal completeness of this normalized realization.

source.place: Proposition 6.6.11; Lemmas 6.5.8 and 6.6.8, with the recorded completed coefficient comparisons.

proof.text: The actual coefficient equivalence sends completed constant realization to this model. Its scalar-preserving normalization identifies the intrinsic Koszul unit with the constant-completion unit. The existing reflector criterion makes that unit invertible for the complete model. Reflect invertibility through the exact derived equivalence and compose with the supplied representative isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem cechPerfectModel_intrinsicComplete (T : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (P : completedConstantDerived (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (hP : @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex A _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) P)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal)
    (C : CochainComplex (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T d)) ℤ)
    (eC : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ (integralConstantDerived T d).obj P) :
    IsDerivedCompleteIntrinsic T d r a ha ((integralConstantDerived T d).obj P) C eC
